about_the_game:
Welcome to Mech Builder 3D — your perfect escape into the Gunpla-inspired world of model building. Experience the relaxing process of building a model kit with complete freedom.

Effortlessly assemble, paint, and pose all your models. Build mechs, monsters, armors, and so much more.

Building all the kits will take around 7-9 hours of your time.

Diorama mode has endless repeatability, where you can display your models or recreate any iconic scene.

All 3D models and pieces have been carefully crafted for a relaxing experience.

Features

  • 60 model kits to build.

  • A pressure-free experience: build your way, at your own pace.

  • Pose the models kits in any position you want.

  • Unlock diorama mode to make your own mini-worlds.

  • Add effects like explosions, particles, and more to bring your dioramas to life.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.66GHz (64 bit)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon HD 7770, GeForce GTX 460 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Requirements may change as development furthers
